issue.title: Marker-audit catalog stale after write_json_marker_atomic on done.json helpers
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/test_agent_artifact_marker_mutation_audit.py::test_tracked_marker_mutation_sites_are_reviewed`

`sase tool run check` 61a94752779044b5903b2dce2930ee5e (19m32s) failed 4 of 56,496 after lint/mypy/symvision green. The dirty tree is only PROC_GEAR_HUE (`#48CAE4` → `#5F87FF`) plus 9 inspected PNG goldens; no `src/sase/axe/**` files are dirty.

The four nodes are one catalog drift:

- `test_tracked_marker_mutation_sites_are_reviewed` — reviewed set still names `src/sase/axe/run_agent_exec_markers.py:write_done_marker_and_update_index` and `src/sase/axe/run_agent_runner_finalize.py:write_error_done_marker`; AST no longer classifies them as mutation sites.
- `test_reviewed_marker_mutation_sites_match_expected_mutations` — expected `('open','dump')` for both; they now call `write_json_marker_atomic`.
- `test_reviewed_marker_mutation_sites_declare_lifecycle_coverage` — KeyError on the first of those two keys (triaged FLAKY; same missing AST site).
- `test_tracked_marker_path_passing_sites_are_reviewed` — AST now reports `write_error_done_marker` as an unreviewed path-passing site.

`write_done_marker_and_update_index` writes `done.json` via `write_json_marker_atomic` then `update_agent_artifact_index_for_marker_mutation`. `write_error_done_marker` does the same after reading `agent_meta.json`. Review whether `write_json_marker_atomic` should count as a tracked mutation helper, then update `_REVIEWED_MARKER_MUTATION_CONTEXTS` / `_REVIEWED_PATH_PASSING_CONTEXTS` (or the scanner) accordingly.

Related but different sites: sase-zi (restart `_write_recovery_files` tuple), sase-1by (`session_root_tab` / `_target_for_dir` path-passing).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Static AST catalog vs source: the same four nodes fail because write_done_marker_and_update_index and write_error_done_marker call write_json_marker_atomic, not open/dump. Repeating the assertion does not change the source.

issue.creation_reason: just check failed four agent-artifact marker-audit nodes because two axe done.json writers now use write_json_marker_atomic instead of open/dump. The PROC_GEAR_HUE tree does not touch those files, so the catalog needs its own owner.
